items.title: Validate moderation options per command before credentials
items.why: Mutation commands accept list filters and ignore them; missing flag values and invalid limits can reach credentials. Unknown options print success-shaped help.
items.userOutcome: Operators cannot accidentally moderate a broader set of comments through silently ignored options.
items.acceptance: Malformed, duplicate, missing, cross-command and conflicting options exit 2 before credentials/network; valid list and mutation inputs preserve their existing requests; help and self-test are inert.

items.title: Reject unintended REST checker modes before filesystem or network
items.why: The checker treats help and unknown flags as an ordinary offline run; --write without --live is silently ignored, and malformed live flags can trigger network probing.
items.userOutcome: Operators receive an explicit failure for misspelled or contradictory validation commands; help remains safe during provider outages.
items.acceptance: Help and preview have zero IO; unknown/duplicate/conflicting options exit 2 before IO; --write requires --live; existing offline, live read-only and live-write modes remain explicit and tested.
